resources.string: No saved computers. To add one, check Save this computer in the connection form.
Disconnect the current session and connect to %1$s?
Enter a name for this computer.
A computer already has this name. Choose another name.
Could not read or save the computer list. Try again.
The connection details changed. Press Connect again.

Check Save this computer before connecting. You will be asked for a name and whether to remember the key. The computer is saved when the PC connects. Saved computers lets you connect, edit or delete entries. The last computer used appears first. If its key was not saved, you will be asked for it when connecting. Manual connection returns to the form to add another computer.
